title: The Ding-Song-Sun inequality for a class of even ferromagnets
summary: Ding-Song-Sun proved the remarkable correlation inequality that the truncated two-point correlation function of ferromagnetic Ising models with arbitrary mixed-sign external field is largest when the field vanishes. This inequality has various important consequences such as log-Sobolev inequalities for Ising and $\varphi^4$ models up to and at the critical point. We extend the DSS inequality to the class of single spin measures satisfying the GHS condition.
